structuredContent.content:
name: PoN isolated cloud build inputs
on:
  pull_request:
    paths:
      - .github/workflows/pon-cloud-build-inputs.yml
      - rust-toolchain.toml
      - trillionnium/Cargo.lock
      - trillionnium/**/Cargo.toml
  workflow_dispatch:
permissions:
  contents: read
concurrency:
  group: pon-cloud-build-inputs-${{ github.event.pull_request.number || github.ref }}
  cancel-in-progress: false
jobs:
  build-inputs:
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    timeout-minutes: 30
    env:
      EXPECTED_HEAD: ${{ github.event.pull_request.head.sha || github.sha }}
      CARGO_BUILD_JOBS: "2"
      CARGO_INCREMENTAL: "0"
      PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE: "1"
    steps:
      - name: Checkout the exact candidate without persistent credentials
        uses: actions/checkout@11d5960a326750d5838078e36cf38b85af677262
        with:
          ref: ${{ env.EXPECTED_HEAD }}
          fetch-depth: 0
          persist-credentials: false
      - name: Verify source and reserve fresh output paths
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          bash scripts/project-preflight.sh --audit
          out="$RUNNER_TEMP/pon-build-inputs-$GITHUB_RUN_ID-$GITHUB_RUN_ATTEMPT"
          mkdir "$out"
          mkdir "$out/bundle"
          printf 'OUT=%s\n' "$out" >> "$GITHUB_ENV"
          printf 'CARGO_HOME=%s/cargo-build-inputs\n' "$RUNNER_TEMP" >> "$GITHUB_ENV"
          printf 'RUSTUP_HOME=%s/rustup-build-inputs\n' "$RUNNER_TEMP" >> "$GITHUB_ENV"
          python3 scripts/ci/verify_ci_source.py --kind head --expected-head "$EXPECTED_HEAD" --output "$out/source-before.json"
      - name: Obtain the pinned compiler and locked source dependencies
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          rustup toolchain install 1.95.0 --profile minimal --component clippy --component rustfmt
          rustc +1.95.0 -Vv > "$OUT/bundle/rustc-version.txt"
          cargo +1.95.0 -Vv > "$OUT/bundle/cargo-version.txt"
          cargo +1.95.0 vendor --locked --manifest-path trillionnium/Cargo.toml "$OUT/bundle/vendor" > "$OUT/bundle/vendor-config.toml"
          cp trillionnium/Cargo.lock "$OUT/bundle/Cargo.lock"
          # Copy only the selected public toolchain and vendored crate sources.
          # Do not archive CARGO_HOME, credentials, runner state or the checkout.
          compiler="$(rustup which --toolchain 1.95.0 rustc)"
          toolchain="$(dirname "$(dirname "$compiler")")"
          cp -a "$toolchain" "$OUT/bundle/toolchain"
          cp "$OUT/source-before.json" "$OUT/bundle/source.json"
          printf 'Build inputs only. No test execution, work-security, model-efficacy, independent-operator or activation qualification is implied.\n' > "$OUT/bundle/SCOPE.txt"
      - name: Verify unchanged source and package the bounded input set
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          python3 scripts/ci/verify_ci_source.py --kind head --expected-head "$EXPECTED_HEAD" --output "$OUT/source-after.json"
          tar -czf "$OUT/pon-cloud-build-inputs.tar.gz" -C "$OUT/bundle" .
          sha256sum "$OUT/pon-cloud-build-inputs.tar.gz" > "$OUT/pon-cloud-build-inputs.sha256"
      - name: Retain exact build inputs for offline cloud verification
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@ea165f8d65b6e75b540449e92b4886f43607fa02
        with:
          name: pon-cloud-build-inputs-${{ env.EXPECTED_HEAD }}-${{ github.run_attempt }}
          path: |
            ${{ runner.temp }}/pon-build-inputs-${{ github.run_id }}-${{ github.run_attempt }}/pon-cloud-build-inputs.tar.gz
            ${{ runner.temp }}/pon-build-inputs-${{ github.run_id }}-${{ github.run_attempt }}/pon-cloud-build-inputs.sha256
            ${{ runner.temp }}/pon-build-inputs-${{ github.run_id }}-${{ github.run_attempt }}/source-before.json
            ${{ runner.temp }}/pon-build-inputs-${{ github.run_id }}-${{ github.run_attempt }}/source-after.json
          if-no-files-found: error
          compression-level: 0
          retention-days: 7
